description: Search the Project Gutenberg catalog by title or author. The local mirror also searches alternative titles. Filter by author, contributor, table of contents, topic, language, translator, author lifespan, IDs, media type, Library of Congress Classification, MIME prefix or copyright status. Check each filter’s local mirror requirements. Results include media type, classification, download counts and readability. Use gutenberg_get_book for full metadata.

author.description: Every word must match one creator’s name or aliases, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

author_year_end.description: Include only books with an author who has a known birth or death year on or before this year. With author_year_start, one author must meet both bounds. Example: author_year_start=1800 with author_year_end=1899 returns books with 19th-century authors.

author_year_start.description: Include only books with an author who has a known birth or death year on or after this year (positive = CE, negative = BCE). With author_year_end, one author must meet both bounds.

contents.description: Literal phrase in the catalog table of contents, ignoring case, accents and whitespace runs. Requires the local mirror.

contributor.description: Every word must match a contributor name, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Narrow results to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs. Use gutenberg_get_book for full single-ID metadata.

languages.description: Filter to books in any of these catalog language codes, exactly as results report them ("en", not "eng"). Example: ["en"] for English, ["fr", "de"] for French or German, ["enm"] for Middle English.

lcc.description: Any listed Library of Congress Classification prefix, ignoring case. Example: ["PS", "PR"]. Requires the local mirror.

media_type.description: Any listed catalog media type, matched exactly ignoring case. Examples: ["Text"], ["Sound"]. Requires the local mirror.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "application/pdf". Type and subtype casing is normalized; parameter suffixes retain literal case. Blank means unset.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (1-indexed). Each page returns up to 32 books. Use totalCount to determine total pages.

query.description: Every word must match the title or an author name as a literal substring. The local mirror also searches alternative titles and ignores case and accents. The live catalog may require accents and accepts at most four words. Example: "dickens expectations".

sort.description: Result ordering. "popular" (default) sorts by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, descending. "ascending" and "descending" sort by Gutenberg ID number.

topic.description: Phrase to match against subjects and bookshelves, ignoring case and, on the local mirror, accents. Example: "detective" matches the "Detective Fiction" bookshelf and "Detective and mystery stories" subject. Separate from query — topic searches categorization metadata, not title/author.

translator.description: Every nonblank whitespace-separated word must match a translator name as a literal substring, ignoring case and accents; words can land on different translators of one book. Requires the local mirror. Example: "maude" finds the Aylmer and Louise Maude translations. Result rows omit translators; gutenberg_get_book reports them.

name: gutenberg_search_books

books.description: Matching books, ordered by the sort parameter.

birth_year.description: Author birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Author death year, or null if unknown or still living.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot.

has_plain_text.description: True for Text records with UTF-8 plain text; HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

id.description: Gutenberg ID — pass to gutenberg_get_book for the full record or gutenberg_get_text to read the book.

is_readable.description: Eligible Text record with UTF-8 plain text, or HTML without audio formats. Does not guarantee the mirror file exists.

languages.description: Catalog language codes for this edition.

lcc.description: Library of Congress Classification codes. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

media_type.description: Catalog media type, such as "Text" or "Sound".

catalogAsOf.description: Last recorded bulk RDF archive checkpoint, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

catalogSource.description: Catalog that answered. Omitted when an empty ID list selects nothing.

effectiveCriteria.description: Normalized search criteria, including sort and page defaults.

author.description: Every word must match one creator’s name or aliases, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

author_year_end.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or before this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_start, one author must meet both bounds.

author_year_start.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or after this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_end, one author must meet both bounds.

contents.description: Literal phrase in the catalog table of contents, ignoring case, accents and whitespace runs. Requires the local mirror.

contributor.description: Every word must match a contributor name, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Restrict to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs.

languages.description: Any listed two- or three-letter catalog language code; empty means all languages.

lcc.description: Any listed Library of Congress Classification prefix, ignoring case. Example: ["PS", "PR"]. Requires the local mirror.

media_type.description: Any listed catalog media type, matched exactly ignoring case. Examples: ["Text"], ["Sound"]. Requires the local mirror.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "application/pdf". Type and subtype casing is normalized; parameter suffixes retain literal case. Blank means unset.

page.description: One-indexed page of at most 32 matches. Pages beyond the result range are errors.

query.description: Every nonblank word must occur in the title or an author name as a literal substring. The local mirror also searches alternative titles and ignores case and accents. Live matching is upstream-defined. More than four words require the local mirror.

sort.description: Popular orders by source-snapshot downloads in the last 30 days, with ID tie-breaks locally; ascending and descending order by Gutenberg ID.

topic.description: Phrase in a subject or bookshelf, ignoring case and, on the local mirror, accents; blank means unset.

translator.description: Every nonblank word must occur in a translator name as a literal substring, ignoring case and accents. Requires the local mirror. Whitespace separates words.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `filter_requires_mirror`: An author, contributor, contents, media type or LCC filter was supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `translator_requires_mirror`: A translator filter was supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `query_requires_mirror`: More than four query words were supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `page_out_of_range`: The requested page number is past the last page of results for this query. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer, or returned an unreadable page, within the time this server allows for one search. `catalog_rejected`: The live Project Gutenberg catalog refused the search outright rather than failing temporarily. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True if there are additional pages of results.

notice.description: Actionable guidance for an empty selection, or a caveat that the live catalog checked author_year_start and author_year_end separately. The caveat can accompany results.

totalCount.description: Total number of books matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Gutenberg Books
